D-18.reason: R1's accepted D-2 reading extended to plans built without plane slots; stricter than SQ4-C5 and admissible because SQ-4 rests on admissibility, stability and the Founder's request with benefit PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNCERTAIN; the cost (no alternation after a template-replacing change of days; the built vertical lifts can leave) is stated, touches no dose, role or stability, and is a Founder-accepted remaining condition; KEEP is the minimum effective change.
conditions: The PLANE record states D-18 as the in-force rule: asks only where built asking; keeps its own while it fits, prefers nothing while it does not, returns when it fits again; no adoption in plans in force; alternation resumes only in a new plan.
